from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DilutedEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Diluted earnings per share data for a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted earnings per share value")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Financial reporting period")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of measurement, e.g. '元/股'")
    section_name: str | None = Field(description="Section of the report where this data was found, e.g. '主要会计数据和财务指标'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    diluted_eps_records: list[DilutedEpsRecord]
